# Constants

ang_to_cm = 1e-8  # angstrom to cm

# Original box dimensions
x = 3.172023  # angstroms
y = 2.747053  # angstroms
z = 5.141205  # angstroms
tilt = -1.586012  # angstroms

# Calculate the volume of the original box in cm^3
volume_ang3 = x * y * z - x * tilt
volume_cm3 = volume_ang3 * ang_to_cm**3

# Replication factor
replication_factor = 5**3

# Mass of one magnesium atom in grams
mass_mg_amu = 24.305
mass_mg_g = mass_mg_amu * amu_to_g

# Total mass of the replicated system
num_atoms = 2
mass_total_g = num_atoms * mass_mg_g * replication_factor

# Calculate density in g/cm^3
density = mass_total_g / (volume_cm3 * replication_factor)

density
